fix.digest: December press reports name Rasmussen as one of the Danish Arctic authorities attached to the examination. The man who had spoken up for the Inughuit testimony thus found himself in the room that rejected Cook's papers. fix.digest: Scott records that Oates asked to be left in his sleeping bag, marched once more, and the next morning said he was going outside and might be some time, and went into the blizzard.
